Subject: Resale certificate bulk upload + validation questions

Hi Diego,

We're preparing a bulk push of ~2,400 resale certificates for the merchants we manage at ClearCart. Before we start, two quick questions:

1) Does Redwood's ingestion process accept a CSV with one certificate per row (certificate PDF URL + ship-to mapping)? Or do you require an SFTP/S3 drop with a manifest?

2) For states with specific forms (TX, WA, KY), what's your validation tolerance? For example, if a Texas ST-2 is missing the handwritten signer but has an EIN and address, do you flag it or accept with a manual review queue?

We've attached a small sample (sample-upload.csv) showing our fields. We'll also need to hold invoices until the batch clears validation — can you confirm the billing hold workflow?

Thanks,
Samantha Cho
Head of Finance Ops
ClearCart, Inc.

Attachment: sample-upload.csv
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-28 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale certificate bulk upload + validation questions

Samantha — thanks for the sample and heads up. Short answers up front: S3 manifest is preferred for large batches, and anything missing a required signer gets routed into a manual-review queue (we won't auto-accept).

Details and next steps:
- Ingest options: we support secure S3 ingestion (pre-signed manifest + zipped PDFs) or a DocuSign envelope link for smaller batches. For S3 ingestion we need: manifest.csv (one line per certificate), certificate_url, ship_to_id, bill_to_ein, state_code, form_type, issue_date, expiration_date, and a flag for blanket:true/false.
- Validation checks we run automatically: state code conformity, EIN format + checksum, expiration (not expired), signer name present for single-use certificates, US state-specific required fields (TX ST-2 requires a signatory and company name match), and ship-to mapping consistency.
- Manual review: certificates that fail automated checks are placed on a "validation hold". Finance is notified and invoices are optionally put on hold. We can toggle hold-per-invoice via the manifest field invoice_hold:true.

Laura — tagging you to confirm the invoice hold workflow (we sometimes get requests to auto-release after verification).

Attached: small sample for formatting reference.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Sample of problematic rows:
- ship_to_id=7501 mapped to PO 98432 in our ERP, but Redwood expects a different ship-to key.

We can harmonize IDs, but that's a big mapping job for us. Is there a way Redwood can accept an alternate key (ship_to_external_id) and map it during ingest?

Also — a couple of certificates are for marketplace sellers where ClearCart is only the platform. Do you accept seller-signed certificates with ClearCart as a reseller on file?

Hi Samantha —

Quick clarifications from Billing:
- Invoice hold: We can place invoice holds per invoice number via the manifest field invoice_hold:true. Holds remain until validation is complete and Finance approves release. Please include expected invoice numbers in the manifest when possible (invoice_number column).
- Marketplace sellers: For marketplace models where ClearCart is an intermediary, we accept seller-signed certificates only if the manifest includes seller_entity_name and seller_ein, and you mark the certificate_type=marketplace. We'll require a seller-delegation statement for batch acceptance — see our intake checklist.
- State forms: TX ST-2 must have signatory name + title and company name. KY has allowances for notarized affidavits in place of original signatures, but they must be notarized and dated. WA (Washington) requires a clear seller address that matches the form.

If you can add ship_to_external_id as an auxiliary column we can update the ingest to map external IDs to our ship_to table as a temporary backfill. That should reduce your mapping work. We'll coordinate a small ETL task to create the mapping table after we see a sample of 500 rows.

I'll take the invoice hold and release duty once validation flags are cleared — please include a contact for daily status checks.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
Finance & Billing

Samantha — tagging in Tax Ops. I've drafted a short ingestion checklist and plan to push a validation-service tweak next week to accept ship_to_external_id as a first-pass map. Key items for your team before full batch: 

1) Normalize manifest columns: certificate_url, ship_to_external_id, ship_to_id (if available), bill_to_ein, seller_entity_name, seller_ein, state_code, form_type, issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), expiration_date (YYYY-MM-DD), blanket (true/false), invoice_number, invoice_hold (true/false).
2) For marketplace sellers, include delegation_statement_url per seller.
3) For Texas and Washington, make sure signer_title is present. We'll also check company name vs EIN via third-party TIN validation.
4) We'll run a pilot (500 certificates). Any fails will be reported in CSV with fail_reason codes (EIN_MISMATCH, EXPIRED, MISSING_SIGNER, SHIPTO_MISMATCH).

Related items: I've opened ticket REV-412 to track the ship_to_external_id mapping and attached an internal ingest checklist (ingest-checklist.pdf). ETA: mapping rollout Wednesday EOD.
